MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
WITH DISTINCT p, t, c,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE DATE_DIFF('year', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')), DATE('2026-10-14')) -
      CASE
        WHEN DATE_PART('month', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-'))) > 10
          OR (DATE_PART('month', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-'))) = 10 AND DATE_PART('day', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-'))) > 14)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
  END AS age
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
WITH DISTINCT p, t, c,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CASE
      WHEN DATE_PART('month', CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END) > 10
        OR (DATE_PART('month', CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END) = 10
          AND DATE_PART('day', CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END) > 14)
      THEN 2026 - DATE_PART('year', CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END) - 1
      ELSE 2026 - DATE_PART('year', CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END)
    END
  END AS age
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
